ceiling_accounting: 2,600 = 200 rows x 13 and 52 = 4 rows x 13, where 13 is the grouped-Solver graph's OWN ceiling at samples 2 as rails.native_episode_config resolves it: 1 + (1 + 1) x (1 x 2 + 3 + 1). Expected spend about 5.2 contacts per row (about 1,040 contacts, about 0.4 GPU hours on the arm), so the ceiling is about 2.5x the expectation. Ceilings are bounds, never targets, and budgets are run-cumulative across every attempt of a run id.

check_receipt.not_run_by_this_registration: DELIBERATELY NOT RUN. A GPU flight was in progress at registration time and core.flight.cli check touches the runtime root and the coordination tree, so this package registers the cells without it. The coordinator's own clean-tree re-pin cycle (scripts/flights/batch/repin_cell_generic.sh, ARM=1) runs check on the minted receipt and asserts the runtime-derived hashes agree with the ones registered here; a disagreement stops the flip, which is the intended failure mode.

comparator_reason: None, by design: an A/A null's two sides are two samples of the same Solver visit of the same flight, so the cell is its own control. No sealed arm is re-flown, re-scored or compared against, and the read is never plan_cell_read.py.

decision_rule.no_gate_number: No threshold is pre-registered on any number this cell produces. Its output is a measurement floor, h_within, which becomes a registered margin for the ROLL-2 variant comparisons -- not a verdict about this cell.
decision_rule.output: h_within (SLU-F1) and h_within_intent: the CI95 half-widths of the pooled micro paired delta (sample 1 minus sample 0) by paired row bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 20260915, reported beside the byte-identical / intent-flip / entity-set-flip shares and the per-stratum table.
decision_rule.rule: DESCRIPTIVE. Nothing is admitted, rejected or locked by this cell. Structural acceptance only: a clean seal, every row delivered, exactly two custodied Solver samples per row in solver_group (invariant I7g) with seeds 2080141211 / 2080141212 and temperature 0.0 on both, the plurality-commit replay reproducing the sealed delivered answer, zero native task-contract calls, every request fitting.

modules.why_a_null_and_not_a_factor: reproduction.ojw.native_group_solver.run_grouped_solver_samples composes N independent Solver invocations of ONE visit through the same metered request path, and reproduction.ojw.native_request.compose_solver_sample_decoding_params overrides exactly two request fields per sample: temperature (0.0 for both) and seed (fragment_seed + seed_offset + sample_index). Every other byte of the two requests is the same object -- same messages, same speech packet, same supplied knowledge, same response format. At temperature 0 the seed is inert, so the residual difference is batch composition alone.

prepared_phase_supply.note: NONE pinned. core.flight.repin mints this cell's OWN model-free first-phase supply under its own run id at the readiness flip (item E16); nothing is inherited from cell ROLL-1 and --allow-output-change must never be passed.

purpose: Cell ROLL-AA (board route F2, docs/handoff/2026-09-24-fable51/HANDOFF-STAGE3-FOR-CHATGPT-v1.md section 7.3): the WITHIN-FLIGHT A/A null of the Stage-3 variant-rollout methodology. The locked v2.0 plan's Solver answers the IDENTICAL prompt TWICE for each of 200 R01C construction rows inside ONE flight, greedy (temperature 0 under the E2b twin 'greedy-repeat' marker), and the offline read reports the per-row paired difference between the two samples. Because the two sides are two contacts of one request, whatever difference appears is the measurement floor itself, and its CI95 half-width becomes h_within -- the margin every ROLL-2 variant comparison at n = 200 is read against. DESCRIPTIVE: no admission verdict, no comparator, no gate.
quality_read_gate: No read of any kind before the complete sealed manifest and the exact ordered outputs with exactly two custodied solver_group samples per row exist. A partial manifest is never read; a failed smoke stops the arm and it does not open.
